governing_question: Does Constitutional Capitalism's economic architecture still work when every optimistic assumption is removed?
stance: We attempt to falsify. Survival is earned. $0 COUNTABLE is a successful research result if evidence does not clear.
countable_verdict: REMAINS_$0 — no engine cleared addressable→…→reserved public cash→COUNTABLE under hostile assumptions. Successful research result.

fiscal_baseline.title: Attack 1 — Arkansas fiscal reality

sources.label: Arkansas DFA Economic Analysis & Tax Research — General Revenue Report for June 2026 (FY 2026)

earmarks.dependency: Special revenues from sales/services/franchise/dyed-diesel increments dedicated to educational adequacy — not available as unconstrained IIT replacement dollars

replacement_requirement.note: Combined ~$7.23B is the preferred map of IIT + layered property — not a single magic tax target. Property layers mix BOUND URT with ESTIMATED local layers.

who_depends.county: County general, roads, libraries, hospitals, colleges, other
who_depends.municipal: City general, pensions, libraries, bonds, parks

fiscal_baseline.what_must_be_replaced_finding: Abolishing personal income and property taxes is not a slogan exercise. Recurring IIT alone is ~$3.86B gross (Grade A). Property layers sum ~$3.37B with URT constitutional and school debt covenant-blocked (Grade A/B mix). Combined illustrative burden ~$7.23B with $0 COUNTABLE replacement capacity now.
fiscal_baseline.modification: Stage 3 ambition language must always display the replacement requirement beside any tax-transition claim.

budget_history.title: Attack 2 — Budget history / Budget X-Ray
budget_history.limitation: Hostile audit does not invent a multi-decade normalized series. FY25→FY26 DFA GR table is bound; Allocation A seed is official for FY2026. Deeper multi-year actual-vs-appropriated and all-funds federal dependency remain OPEN (OV-31-01).

patterns_observed.finding: IIT and Sales & Use dominate GR — together ~$7.53B of $8.69B gross FY2026
Net available GR ($7.15B) is far below gross after refunds and earmarked transfers
Educational Adequacy Fund ~$778M is dedicated — not free replacement cash
Allocation A seed: DHS ~$1.86B, higher ed ~$778M, corrections ~$629M among large consumers
Formula-driven and constitutional/statutory constraints are material; discretionary share is not the whole budget

unknowns: Pension/OPEB and other off-appropriations liabilities full map
Which spending creates future capacity vs maintains capacity — requires program-level classification pass
budget_history.modification: Do not claim a complete Budget X-Ray until multi-year all-funds series is bound. Current X-Ray is PARTIAL and labeled as such.

tax_replacement_mathematics.title: Attack 3 — Tax replacement mathematics
tax_replacement_mathematics.status_note: FAILED means: no feeder clears the full waterfall to COUNTABLE > $0 under hostile assumptions. Architecture of the waterfall SURVIVED.

stack_verdicts.dual_abolition: FAILS Base@16y and fails again after feeder demotion
stack_verdicts.rule: Illustrative envelopes are not COUNTABLE. Demotion was required; promotion was not earned.

scenarios.CONSERVATIVE: Feeder demotion Base@16y ceiling ~$0.84B illustrative (~12% of combined target) — still $0 COUNTABLE
scenarios.UPSIDE: Accelerated demoted ~$1.35B illustrative (~19%) — still $0 COUNTABLE; dual abolition still fails
scenarios.FAILURE: Utilization half / margins compress / capital doubles / revenue five years late / federal falls → COUNTABLE remains $0; Dependency Rule forbids removing legacy taxes

tax_replacement_mathematics.verdict: Tax-transition ambition without replacement capacity is falsified as near-term COUNTABLE policy. Waterfall firewall SURVIVED because it correctly refused fake cash.

public_ownership_attack.title: Attack 4 — Public ownership
hostile_questions: Why wouldn't private capital do this better?
What return compensates taxpayers for risk?
What happens when the enterprise loses money?
Does government receive unfair regulatory advantages?
Does public capital crowd out private capital?
public_ownership_attack.finding: Public ownership is not automatically superior. Hostile audit supports ownership-by-function: private / regulated private / cooperative / public-private / public must be compared per system. Soft-budget and Role Conflict risks are real (route deeper operationalization to 4.2/4.5).
public_ownership_attack.modification: Any public-income claim must show why private/coop alternatives fail the Productive Systems + Role Conflict tests before public ownership is preferred.

productive_retention_attack.title: Attack 5 — Productive retention
productive_retention_attack.finding: Retaining Arkansas dollars is not automatically wealth-creating. Hostile reading: shifting spend to a more expensive local producer can destroy household surplus while looking like 'local success.' Extraction Test must distinguish capacity-building retention from costly diversion.
productive_retention_attack.modification: Productive retention claims require a counterfactual price/quality/capacity test before celebration. Autarky framing remains REJECTED.
productive_retention_attack.empirical_teeth_status: UNPROVEN at statewide scale — OV-31-02 capital-leakage estimate still open

external_income_attack.title: Attack 6 — External income
external_income_attack.ranking_rule: Candidates compete. Some should lose. Public claim only after waterfall.

candidates.existing: Visitor spend envelope bound; 2% tax ~$27M already spent
candidates.rank_note: Real activity; weak incremental public cash for tax replacement

candidates.verdict: UNPROVEN — priority for deeper bind, not celebration

candidates.existing: Food-hub cashflow closed Stage 3; free cash NEE (OV-36-01)

external_income_attack.finding: No external-income candidate clears to COUNTABLE public cash in Pass 4.1. Enthusiasm is not evidence.

household_transmission.title: Attack 7 — Household transmission
household_transmission.finding: GSP-up / household-flat is a fail under CC's own test. Hostile audit affirms household pathways (wages, prices, housing, taxes, healthcare, energy, time, ownership, wealth) as mandatory transmission checks — not optional rhetoric.
household_transmission.modification: None to architecture; incidence microsim still open (OV-34-04) so quantitative clearance is UNPROVEN.

distribution_attack.title: Attack 8 — Distribution / who captures upside
risks: Public investment → land values → homeowners gain / renters lose
distribution_attack.finding: Distribution risks are real attack vectors. Household Prosperity Ledger must be used as an attack instrument, not a branding device.
distribution_attack.modification: Any public investment proposition must state expected incidence across owners vs renters and wage vs price channels — or be graded UNPROVEN.

geographic_attack.title: Attack 9 — Geographic economics
geographic_attack.risk: NWA wins / Delta loses; metro grows / rural hollows; investment follows easy returns
geographic_attack.finding: Geographic Money Statement architecture is the right instrument; county ownership geography and leakage estimates are not yet bound tightly enough to certify geographic neutrality.
geographic_attack.modification: Do not claim geographically just outcomes without GMS evidence.

transition_cost_attack.title: Attack 10 — Transition cost
transition_cost_attack.finding: Even if Future Arkansas is richer, the bridge costs money: capex, admin, tech, workforce, temporary duplication, reserves, transition assistance, debt, opportunity cost, forgone legacy revenue. Pass 3.7 Dependency Rule and Replacement Readiness survive hostile reading because they forbid pretending the bridge is free.
transition_cost_attack.modeled_status: QUALITATIVE_ACKNOWLEDGED — no fabricated dollar schedule; FAILURE scenario includes late/half utilization
transition_cost_attack.modification: Any transition narrative must list bridge cost categories even when dollars remain UNKNOWN.
